listing.name: Hull Livery
listing.summary: Installs hull mods on ships to change their sprite and livery.
listing.aiSummary: Installs hull mods on ships to change their sprite and livery.

description: Installs hull mods on ships to change their sprite and livery. Currently available liveries include Persean, Hegemony, LG, LC, Tritach, Civilian, Pather, Pirate, Phase, Factory unpainted, and Special for Eagle, and Vanilla enhanced and Vanilla enhanced-alt for Radiant. A list of permitted ships prevents crashing the game by installing on incompatible hulls.
